component.name: PaymentCard
component.business_context: Display of a saved payment method in the merchant dashboard with selection and deletion capabilities

constraints: Card number must be masked except last 4 digits
Show card brand icon (Visa, Mastercard, or Amex)

missing_states: hover — card should have a distinct hover style to signal interactivity
focus-visible — keyboard focus ring must be visible when card is focused
disabled — card may need to be non-selectable (e.g. expired card)
loading — async selection or deletion in progress
deleting — intermediate state while delete API call is in flight
error — failed deletion or failed card load should surface an error
accessibility_gaps: Masked card number must have aria-label='Card ending in 1234' so screen readers announce the meaningful portion, not the bullet characters

Card brand icon (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) must use Icon with aria-hidden=true when the brand name is present as adjacent text; if icon is the sole brand indicator, provide aria-label='Visa' (or relevant brand)
Selectable card must use Card with interactive=true so it renders as <button> with keyboard activation support
Selected state must be announced to assistive technology via aria-pressed (automatically set by Card selected=true when interactive=true)
Expiry date should be wrapped in a <time> element or given an aria-label such as 'Expires 12/26' to avoid ambiguous number strings
Delete IconButton must have aria-label='Delete card ending in 1234' — include the last 4 digits to disambiguate when multiple cards are present
Delete confirmation Modal must trap focus and return focus to the triggering delete button on close
During the deleting state, the delete IconButton should be disabled and a Spinner with label='Deleting card' should be rendered to announce progress via aria-live
Error messages (deletion failure, load failure) must be surfaced via a component that uses role=alert so they are announced immediately
responsive_gaps: Delete IconButton touch target must be at least 44×44 px on mobile — use size='lg' or add padding via spacing tokens if size='md' falls short
Card layout must reflow gracefully on narrow viewports (< 375 px) — cardholder name and expiry should stack vertically rather than overflow
Selected state focus ring (--color-focus-ring) must remain visible on both light and dark backgrounds at all viewport sizes
Masked card number with bullet characters can overflow on small screens — ensure text truncation or wrapping is handled explicitly
recommendations: Use Card with interactive=true and selected={isSelected} and onClick={handleSelect} for the selectable card container
Use Card with padding='md' as the default padding size; increase to padding='lg' if content density requires it
Use Icon with name='visa', name='mastercard', or name='amex' and aria-hidden=true (when brand label text is present) for the card brand icon
Use IconButton with variant='destructive', size='md', aria-label='Delete card ending in {last4}', and onClick={handleDeleteIntent} for the delete trigger
Use Modal with title='Delete card' and open={isDeleteModalOpen} and onClose={handleModalClose} for the delete confirmation dialog
Use Button with variant='destructive' and loading={isDeleting} inside the Modal for the confirm-delete action — loading=true renders Spinner and disables click automatically
Use Button with variant='secondary' inside the Modal for the cancel action
Use Spinner with size='sm' and label='Deleting card' as an inline replacement for the delete IconButton during the deleting state
Use Badge with variant='danger' and children='Expired' to flag expired cards in the disabled state
Use --color-focus-ring for the focus-visible ring on the interactive Card
Use --color-danger for destructive action affordances (delete icon, error text) to stay consistent with design tokens
Use --color-neutral-600 for secondary text (cardholder name, expiry) and --color-neutral-900 for primary text (masked card number)
Use --spacing-4 for internal card padding and --spacing-2 for gaps between card content elements
Use --radius-md on the Card to match the standard card border-radius token
